name: GB energy supply margins
value: No notice found; 5.9 GW winter margin
summary: No Electricity Margin Notice or Gas Margins Notice found for late November; NESO expects a secure winter
state: NESO's winter outlook of 23 Oct expects British electricity supplies to remain secure this winter, with a forecast surplus of 5.9 GW, about 9.5% of peak demand (NESO). Its earlier view flagged possible tight days mainly in mid and late January (Drax). Searches on 27 Nov found no Electricity Margin Notice, capacity market notice or Gas Margins Notice issued in November, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: Households are not affected. Margin notices, if issued in cold, still spells, are routine signals to generators and do not by themselves mean supply is at risk.
rubric_hit: Normal: no NESO or National Gas notices found; NESO forecasts 5.9 GW winter margin

sources.title: NESO — British electricity supplies secure this winter despite global instability
Drax — NESO forecasts adequate but lower supply margins this winter

why: When gas or electricity margins tighten, Britain risks price spikes and, at worst, controlled disconnections in winter.
drivers: Gas imports and storage, wind output, interconnectors, plant outages, cold weather.

rubric.alert: A Gas Deficit Warning, a high risk of demand control notice, or demand control used.
rubric.watch: NESO issues an Electricity Margin Notice or capacity market notice, or National Gas issues a Gas Margins Notice.
rubric.normal: NESO and National Gas report adequate margins; no notices issued.
